blocks.text: Chilliwack Downtown Homes for Sale | Central Chilliwack Real Estate

parts.t: Downtown Chilliwack offers a walkable lifestyle with shops, cafes, and the revitalized District 1881. The area has condos, townhomes, and character homes. Browse all Downtown Chilliwack homes for sale below, and contact Jared today for expert guidance.
For Five Corners, Salish Park, the Downtown Neighbourhood Plan and the flood proofing rules, see my
Chilliwack Downtown neighbourhood guide

Chilliwack's downtown is experiencing exciting urban revival, offering heritage character, walkable living, and the authentic city atmosphere that attracts diverse buyers. This historic core features everything from character homes in established neighbourhoods to modern condos and townhomes in new developments transforming the urban landscape. Residents love walkability to local shops, restaurants, breweries, and cafes creating vibrant street life, plus community events bringing neighbours together year-round. Explore Chilliwack Proper West and Chilliwack Proper East, plus Fairfield Island and Little Mountain, for more central community options.

The area provides convenient access to schools, recreation facilities including Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, and services all within the compact downtown. Cultural venues, farmers market, and heritage buildings add character while ongoing revitalization brings new amenities and improvements. Properties offer exceptional value with downtown convenience that reduces vehicle reliance, particularly appealing to young professionals and downsizers. Despite urban location, natural beauty and outdoor recreation remain minutes away. Chilliwack's downtown transformation creates opportunities for those recognizing potential. parts.t: Chilliwack Downtown

is a key residential search area in the eastern Fraser Valley connected via Yale Road, Young Road, Wellington Avenue, Five Corners, First Avenue, and Highway 1 Exit 119 / Exit 123. Buyers comparing active MLS® listings in Chilliwack Downtown will find low-rise apartment condos (many priced under $500K–$650K), infill townhomes, character detached homes on mature 6,000 to 8,500 sq ft lots, and multi-family redevelopment parcels. blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Chilliwack Downtown

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Chilliwack Downtown are served by Central Elementary Community School (9435 Young Road), Bernard Elementary, Chilliwack Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School (46363 Yale Road) in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include District 1881 heritage courtyard shops and restaurants, Central Community Park, the Chilliwack Cultural Centre, Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, Prospera Centre, and Chilliwack Library. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by the Downtown Chilliwack Exchange on Yale Road served by BC Transit Routes 51, 52, 53, 57, 58, 59, 66 (Fraser Valley Express to Langley/Lougheed SkyTrain), 71, and 72.

blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use Plans & Buyer Due Diligence in Chilliwack Downtown

parts.t: Land use and building permits in Chilliwack Downtown are regulated by the Downtown Chilliwack Neighbourhood Plan and Chilliwack 2050 OCP Urban Quarter designations, which support mid-rise residential and mixed-use infill around District 1881 and Young Road. Before removing subjects on a property in Chilliwack Downtown, verify the title search (checking for statutory building schemes, easements, geotechnical or floodplain covenants, and freehold vs. leasehold tenure) and estimate your closing taxes with our
BC Property Transfer Tax Calculator
and

What types of homes are for sale in Chilliwack Downtown?

Active MLS® listings in Chilliwack Downtown typically include low-rise apartment condos (many priced under $500K–$650K), infill townhomes, character detached homes on mature 6,000 to 8,500 sq ft lots, and multi-family redevelopment parcels. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Chilliwack Downtown in Chilliwack School District 33?

Schools serving or located near Chilliwack Downtown include Central Elementary Community School (9435 Young Road), Bernard Elementary, Chilliwack Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School (46363 Yale Road) in SD33. Because SD33 catchment boundaries go by street address, always verify a specific property using the official SD33 School Locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Chilliwack Downtown?

Residents of Chilliwack Downtown have access to District 1881 heritage courtyard shops and restaurants, Central Community Park, the Chilliwack Cultural Centre, Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, Prospera Centre, and Chilliwack Library. See our
Chilliwack Downtown Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Chilliwack Downtown?

Key road corridors serving Chilliwack Downtown include Yale Road, Young Road, Wellington Avenue, Five Corners, First Avenue, and Highway 1 Exit 119 / Exit 123. Public transit connections include the Downtown Chilliwack Exchange on Yale Road served by BC Transit Routes 51, 52, 53, 57, 58, 59, 66 (Fraser Valley Express to Langley/Lougheed SkyTrain), 71, and 72.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Chilliwack Downtown?

Properties in Chilliwack Downtown are governed by the Downtown Chilliwack Neighbourhood Plan and Chilliwack 2050 OCP Urban Quarter designations, which support mid-rise residential and mixed-use infill around District 1881 and Young Road. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Chilliwack Downtown freehold or leasehold?

Most residential properties in Chilliwack Downtown are freehold (fee simple) or freehold strata, though select developments in the broader Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region sit on prepaid leasehold land. Always check the Title Type field on each MLS® listing and review the title search with your Realtor and lawyer.
